title: Run Locally
description: All services run in Docker on your machine. No AWS account needed, no surprise bills, no network dependency. Just 'docker compose up' and go.

title: AWS SDK Compatible
description: Works with the real AWS CLI, SDKs (JavaScript, Python, Go, Java), and tools. Point your endpoint to localhost and your existing code works.

title: Pick Your Services
description: Run only what you need. Start just S3, or spin up the full stack. Each service runs independently with configurable ports.
